body:
Are you a parent with a young actor in the family? The world of child acting can be both exciting and overwhelming. How do you know if your child has what it takes, and how can you help them reach their full potential?

That's where professional talent evaluations come in, and our unique, blended approach of online courses and private coaching can make all the difference.

Introducing REPORT CARD: A Transformative Experience

Our specialized 5-week online Talent Evaluation Course is designed for young actors aged 8-14, both those new to acting and those seeking to sharpen their skills. It offers a focused, dynamic learning experience:

  • Week 1: Sitcom Scene Mastery – Timing, expression, and landing those laughs.

  • Week 2: Dramatic Impact – Nurturing emotional depth for powerful performances.

  • Week 3: Commercial Casting – Enthusiasm, relatability, and selling the product.

  • Week 4: Charismatic Presence – Building the confidence and magnetism that commands attention.

  • Week 5: Audition Success – Mastering techniques with recent TV/film sides, culminating in a mock audition.

The Benefits of Our Course

  • Personalized Report Card: Each student gets a comprehensive analysis of strengths, weaknesses, and actionable next steps.

  • Industry Insights: Working with experienced professionals unlocks insider tips.

  • Limited Enrollment: Only four spots ensure your child gets the attention they deserve.

Act Now! This Friday, May 10th, our course begins!

Why Professional Talent Evaluations Matter

In the competitive world of child acting, feedback is essential. Here's why evaluations are a game-changer:

  • Individualized Growth: Evaluations uncover your child's specific areas for improvement.

  • Industry Knowledge: Learn directly from professionals what casting directors want.

  • Versatility: Our evaluations cover multiple genres, preparing young actors for diverse roles.

Introducing One-on-One Coaching with Corey Ralston

For the ultimate in personalized development, we now offer ongoing private coaching sessions with Corey Ralston. These sessions offer:

  • Targeted Skill Development: Drill down on your child's unique needs and goals.

  • Flexible Scheduling: Sessions fit your lifestyle.

  • Continuous Growth: Regularly assess progress and redirect for maximum impact.

The Child Actor 101 Advantage

Our Youth Actor Evaluation program is your child's key to unlocking their full potential. Combining group learning with an option for private coaching delivers:

  • Four (30 min) Coaching Sessions: Intensive, genre-specific training.

  • Self-Tape Assignments: Practice applying lessons.

  • Feedback and Redirects: Help refine performances in real time.

  • Evaluation of Skill & Charisma: Get the complete picture of your child's abilities.

The Choice is Yours

Whether in our group course or via private coaching, professional evaluations are an investment in your child's future. Give them the tools, the confidence, and the competitive edge to turn their acting dreams into a brilliant reality.

Enroll today in private Talent Evaluation to elevate your child's career!
